name: Grappling Hook Effects
description: The Grappling Hook's look and sound on everyone's screen: the Printer it is built from rebuilt as a riveted gunmetal winch gun with brass drum bands and a glowing gauge; a forged four-claw grapnel that flies out, springs open and bites, riding along on players and vehicles; a taut steel cable that buzzes as it takes the load; and sounds for firing, biting, winching and letting go.
